item.title: A culinary map of world’s sacred Ramadan traditions
item.description: RAMADAN is just around the corner. Be­ginning in mid-February in the UK and lasting for around a month, it is a sa­cred time for Muslims across the world. During Ramadan, Muslims fast from dawn until dusk, abstaining from food, drink and immoral behaviour – which is all part of Sawm (fasting), one of the five pillars of Islam. item.title: Bank of England cuts growth forecasts, holds rate at 3.75 per cent
item.description: THE BANK OF ENGLAND on Thursday cut its forecasts for UK economic growth this year and next, while keeping its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.75 per cent.The central bank now expects gross domestic product growth of 0.9 per cent this year and 1.5 per cent in 2027. item.description: Three sisters aged 16, 14 and 12 died after jumping from their ninth-floor flat in Ghaziabad on February 4.
